segment: Offline travel agents and tour operators
recommended_action: Lowest underlying cancel rate (17.5% excluding Non Refund). Protect the relationship and test resort-stay offers, since only about a third of their bookings are resort.

Half their bookings are Non Refund, recorded as about 99% cancelled. Excluding those, cancellation is 32%. Investigate how Non Refund bookings are recorded before acting, and use rooming-list deadlines to manage their 185-day lead times.
Biggest source of cancellations (about 57% of the total, and more once Non Refund is set aside). Small improvements matter most here, so add reconfirmation reminders on long-lead bookings.
